purpose: Diagnose the Weekly Report render-retry trajectory and verify validator/runtime alignment on a new target.
data_class: fully synthetic; no production records or Work Profile
tools: isolated local MCP fixture; read-only synthetic materials and references; document write routed to an in-memory fake sink

scenario.target: absent synthetic weekly-meeting document with resolved synthetic parent
scenario.source_facts: none; all four business reports unsubmitted
scenario.expected: validator reports every renderer-required omission before render; corrected report renders and fake readback matches

runs.name: installed_validator_diagnostic
runs.inference: The validator and renderer contracts were misaligned: a publishable report could still fail on fields consumed by rendering.

runs.name: candidate_with_reuse_instruction_probe
runs.delta: Only the synthetic test prompt added an instruction to render once and reuse the returned JSONML unless report content changes.
runs.conclusion: The extra instruction did not remove the duplicate identical render call; do not add it to the installed Skill based on this sample.

limits: The three runs have different provider cache and token usage; token totals are not a controlled cost comparison.
The fake write/readback is local and in-memory; no real document, business MCP, production data, profile, or external action was used.
The native runs validate this synthetic new-target path, not every Weekly Report scenario or production deployment.
